Name: (CP) Mini Farm as new farm
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][center][size=6]The original mod is "[color=#00ff00][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10451]Mini Farm[/url]﻿[/color]".
Originally written by "[color=#00ffff]Irg3ndwas[/color]".[/size][/center]
[/quote]﻿﻿Thanks to Irg3ndwas for the great farm map!

Due to the nature of this farm map, I thought it would be used when starting a new game, so I created it as a new farm type.

Currently, we support notation in English and Japanese.

[color=#00ff00][size=5]About farm selection.[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]New data creation screen.[/*]
[*]Press the arrow.[/*]
[*]It is added as a new farm type.[/*]
[/list][img]https://imgur.com/2Uex0mq.jpg[/img]﻿

[size=5][color=#00ffff]How to install the mod.[/color][/size]
Unzip this mod.
Place the folder that comes up in the /Mods folder.

Unzip the original "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10451]Mini Farm[/url]".
Copy the file "MiniFarm.tbin" in the folder that comes up.
(It is located inside the “assets” folder.)

Open the folder for this mod in "/Mods" that you just placed.
Paste the "MiniFarm.tbin" file you just copied into the "/assets" folder.
(Do not place the original “Mini Farm” folder in the “/Mods” folder.)

If you start the game, it is added as a new type of farm.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/1vc91AH.png[/img]

Added "Farm Type" to the ModConfig settings.
Some minor adjustments to the various warp locations.
The original mod had a tomb already set up, so I removed the option to change the tomb's location.
